interpretation.plain_speak: The closer an example is to the decision boundary, the better the warning. Raw margin beats the coarse rank-plus-history score on this fresh phase. History still matters, but quantizing the signal into a few cells throws away useful detail.
interpretation.north_star_question: Identifies continuous margin as the strongest B-lane native failure-ranking signal so far, but it still needs independent replication before calibration or intervention use.
